items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: I say Benny and Irvin Fazola. Benny's technique and Faz's sound, and his feeling for the blues.

ctx.x: Pete Fountain, I'd like to ask you, were you influenced much at all by Benny Goodman in any way?
I say Benny and Irvin Fazola. Benny's technique and Faz's sound, and his feeling for the blues.
Now, those would be the two clarinetes that are the most influenced on you, you would say.
